name: joshspeagle-site
description: Build entry points for joshspeagle.com. `npm run build` is the single source of build order (tokens -> fonts -> HTML + sitemap); `npm run check` runs the correctness checks over the result (including that publications.bib matches the publication cache). CI runs both.

scripts.build: python scripts/build_tokens.py && python scripts/setup_fonts.py && python scripts/build_html.py
